run_retrieve: run the retrieve function to download class images from LAION using a text prompt and save them to a directory
run_parse_args: run the parse_args function to parse command-line arguments for class prompt, data directory, and image count
run_retrieve_cli: run the retrieve module as a CLI script with --class_prompt, --class_data_dir, and --num_class_images arguments
test_retrieve: test the retrieve function with a class prompt to verify image download and caption file generation
test_parse_args: test the parse_args function to verify correct parsing of --class_prompt, --class_data_dir, and --num_class_images
